cases.sentence: Потому что из сердца исходят ___, убийства, супружеская неверность, разврат, воровство, лжесвидетельство, клевета.
cases.explain: «злые мысли» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: For out of the heart come evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, sexual sins, thefts, false testimony, and blasphemies.

cases.sentence: Там к Нему с плачем подошла ___ и стала кричать:
cases.explain: «местная женщина-хананеянка» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Behold, a Canaanite woman came out from those borders, and cried, saying, “Have mercy on me, Lord, you son of David! My daughter is severely possessed by a demon!”

cases.sentence: Иисус ушел оттуда и пошел вдоль ___.
cases.explain: «Галилейского озера» — after the preposition «вдоль», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Jesus departed from there, and came near to the sea of Galilee; and he went up into the mountain, and sat there.
